answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the anchor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Work waits on the quartz until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the atlas of the next round. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
